Mutations M1 through M5 are each caught and the unmutated case M0 raises no alarm.

findings.found_by: the Cursor Bugbot check run on pull request 244 head d4eb281, 2026-09-04, which reported three medium-severity findings. Each was then confirmed independently against the committed source before being recorded here; a checker's report is not accepted as a finding until the finding is reproduced.

confirmed_findings.defect: the reconstruction is profile_from_bits(bits[:stored] + bits[stored:], n), which is an identity on the full bit vector for every value of stored, and the emitted 'exact' field is the literal True. The loop over stored varies nothing, so no storage bit is ever withheld and no coordinate query is ever issued.
confirmed_findings.consequence: the 5,329 reconstruction checks do not test the RCL-1c storage/query frontier they are cited for.
confirmed_findings.confirmation: bits[:s] + bits[s:] == bits verified for every split of a 5-element vector; the literal '"exact": True' located in the committed source.

confirmed_findings.defect: one coordinate of a copied signature tuple is flipped and the copy is compared to the original, so mutation_detected is True for every boolean vector.
confirmed_findings.consequence: the mutation control cannot detect a mutated profile, a colliding signature, or a broken signature function.
confirmed_findings.confirmation: true for all 16 boolean 4-vectors, with no vector making it False.

confirmed_findings.defect: live(full, revoked) is stored twice under two keys and agreement is len(set(values)) == 1, so the comparison is x == x.
confirmed_findings.consequence: no distinct complete-updater path is exercised and the control cannot catch a false retraction or a live() that always returns the same boolean.
confirmed_findings.confirmation: the exact two-line source pattern located in the committed source; agreement holds for either value of live().
